f.n: Apostle Islands National Lakeshore - Gull and Eagle Island Closure
f.pu: To protect colonial nesting birds. These islands are very small, rocky, and generally inaccessible in all but the most ideal conditions. But together, they are one of the largest colonial bird rookeries on Western Lake Superior, with hundreds of exposed nests covering the ground every year. Human a…
f.re: Gull and Eagle Islands are closed to protect colonial nesting birds, 500 feet seaward from shore, from 15 May to 1 September.
